actor_dps_rule:
(one value per spec per kill, like the existing manifests):
- blood_death_knight: the boss tank row (role tank). With several Blood DK tanks,
  the one with the highest active %, then DPS; the others are excluded.
- other gated specs: rows in the dps role. Several actors of one spec in a kill
  are averaged.
- Outliers are excluded (user clarification 2026-09-30: gear match first, parse
  secondary, competent representative players): an actor who died before 85% of
  the kill, an actor below max(50%, raid DPS median active % - 20), an extreme parse (95+ or below 10), or an actor
  whose own item level is more than 12 from the roster's 359 (outside 347-371).
- Kills whose raid DPS median activity is below 75% (slowed, achievement or
  carry kills; competent kills at this gear run 90-98%) are context only.
- Only kills with raid item level 352-366 enter the median; near-band kills are
  recorded separately and never enter a target.
hotfix_cutoff_note: T11-era kills (before the 2025-02-20T23:00Z 4.4.2 cutoff) are preferred; each reference carries after_hotfix_cutoff_2025_02_20.
target_scope_rule: Default damage-done view with All Enemies (the four constructs and Poison Bombs); no creature entry is excluded, so the bots' native encounter-window DPS counts every enemy of the node alike.
